title: Formal idioms for academic writing
titleVi: Thành ngữ trang trọng dùng trong bài luận học thuật
description: Bộ thành ngữ và cụm cố định đủ trang trọng để dùng trong Task 2. Mỗi mục có nghĩa tiếng Việt và ví dụ trong ngữ cảnh học thuật, tránh kiểu thành ngữ chỉ hợp văn nói.
ieltsUse: Dùng ở câu mở bài, câu nhượng bộ và câu kết luận của Task 2; giúp bài viết tự nhiên hơn mà vẫn giữ được giọng học thuật.

words.vi: con dao hai lưỡi (lợi và hại song hành)
words.def: something with equally significant benefits and drawbacks
words.example: Social media is a double-edged sword: it connects people but also isolates them.

words.vi: phần nổi của tảng băng, chỉ là bề mặt của vấn đề
words.def: a small visible part of a much larger problem
words.example: Reported fraud cases are only the tip of the iceberg in online banking.
collocations: just the tip of the iceberg
only the tip of the iceberg

words.vi: vòng luẩn quẩn
words.def: a situation in which a problem causes the conditions that worsen it
words.example: Poverty and poor schooling form a vicious circle that is hard to break.
collocations: be trapped in a vicious circle

words.vi: về lâu dài
words.def: over a long period rather than immediately
words.example: Preventive spending saves money in the long run, even though it looks costly now.
collocations: in the long run, this pays off

words.vi: đánh đổi bằng cái gì, gây thiệt hại cho
words.def: in a way that harms something else
words.example: Economic growth achieved at the expense of the environment cannot last.

words.vi: ngay sau, do hậu quả của
words.def: following and as a result of an event
words.example: In the wake of the pandemic, remote work became standard in many firms.
collocations: in the wake of the crisis
in the wake of these changes

words.vi: mở đường cho
words.def: to make something possible in the future
words.example: Early investment in rail helped pave the way for rapid industrial growth.

words.vi: bước đệm
words.def: a stage that helps someone reach a larger goal
words.example: A vocational qualification is often a stepping stone to self-employment.

words.vi: hiện trạng
words.def: the existing state of affairs
words.example: Defenders of the status quo argue that reform would disrupt services.

words.vi: làm lung lay, đặt nghi vấn về
words.def: to make people doubt something
words.example: The scandal may call into question the reliability of official statistics.

words.vi: đơm hoa kết trái, mang lại kết quả
words.def: to produce successful results after time
words.example: The literacy programme began to bear fruit after three years of steady funding.

words.vi: sân chơi bình đẳng
words.def: a situation in which everyone competes on equal terms
words.example: Free tuition would create a level playing field for students from poorer families.
collocations: compete on a level playing field

words.vi: làm tắt, làm ẩu để tiết kiệm
words.def: to do something cheaply or quickly by ignoring standards
words.example: Contractors who cut corners on safety eventually face far larger costs.

words.vi: trước, đối mặt với (khó khăn)
words.def: when confronted with a difficult situation
words.example: In the face of rising costs, many small firms have reduced staff.

words.vi: sắp sửa, trên bờ vực của
words.def: very close to a particular state or event
words.example: Several coastal towns are on the verge of being abandoned as sea levels rise.
collocations: on the verge of a breakthrough

words.vi: chấp nhận, làm quen với điều khó khăn
words.def: to gradually accept something difficult
words.example: Workers must come to terms with the fact that some roles will disappear.
collocations: struggle to come to terms with

words.vi: gây tác động xấu tích tụ, ăn mòn dần
words.def: to cause gradual damage or suffering
words.example: Years of underfunding continue to take its toll on rural clinics.

words.vi: nhìn lại thì, theo lẽ thường sau khi việc đã xảy ra
words.def: looking back at a past event with present knowledge
words.example: In hindsight, the decision to deregulate the banks was clearly reckless.

words.vi: vì lợi ích của, vì mục đích của
words.def: for the purpose or benefit of something
words.example: Some argue that growth should be slowed for the sake of the environment.
collocations: for the sake of future generations

words.vi: giọt nước trong đại dương, quá nhỏ so với vấn đề
words.def: an amount far too small to make a difference
words.example: The aid package is a drop in the ocean compared with the damage caused.
collocations: just a drop in the ocean
little more than a drop in the ocean

words.vi: trở ngại
words.def: an obstacle that prevents progress
words.example: The cost of childcare is a stumbling block for many working mothers.

words.vi: vô số, hàng loạt
words.def: a very large number of things
words.example: Students face a myriad of choices that their parents never had.

words.vi: cân nhắc mọi mặt thì
words.def: after considering all the advantages and disadvantages
words.example: On balance, the benefits of university expansion outweigh the costs.

words.vi: xét mọi khía cạnh
words.def: taking every relevant factor into account
words.example: All things considered, raising the retirement age seems the least painful option.

words.vi: dốc trượt (một khi bắt đầu sẽ dẫn tới hậu quả xấu hơn)
words.def: a course of action that leads to increasingly bad consequences
words.example: Critics see any relaxation of the rules as a slippery slope towards deregulation.
collocations: argue that it is a slippery slope
